audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is written as Yorick's E throughout ('his E (Dark Procession) cage', 'E-cage', 'his E ring'). Dark Procession is W. His E is Mourning Mist, which is the thing that actually marks, slows and strips armour — and it is never mentioned by name.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', 600 range, 20/18/16/14/12s. E 'throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets', 700 range, 12/11/10/9/8s.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession (W) = the destructible wall that cuts the escape; Mourning Mist (E) = the mark that slows you and pulls the ghouls onto you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four level rows disagree with the packet chart and the matchup's own why text: Level 1 is Kennen although whys[0] says it reads even; Levels 4-5 are 'Skill' although whys[3] says he reclaims the window; First item is 'Skill' although whys[5] says your burst peaks there; 2+ items is Kennen although whys[6] and the late paragraph both say Yorick out-scales hard.
audit.why: Yorick has no ranged answer to a 950-range Q before Maiden, and Eulogy of the Isles at 160s rank 1 is the hinge — after it lands the ghouls out-DPS the poke, and at two items the splitpush is his.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = Yorick, First item = Kennen, 2+ items = Yorick.

audit.why: Kennen at 2-3, level 6 and first item is right. Yorick's defining spike is Eulogy of the Isles at 160/130/100s — long enough that a Maiden used badly is a real window for Kennen.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is HARD and the win rate is 47.35%, but the final rating line renders 'Even matchup — difficulty 6/10'.
audit.why: A sub-50% lane already flagged HARD cannot render as even.
audit.corrected: diffRating 7/10 and the rating line rewritten as hard.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears in the item list but nowhere in the trade rules, and Last Rites' auto-attack reset is not given as a tell.
audit.why: Last Rites deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals him, on 6s at rank 1, and it is flagged as an auto reset — so it is both the healing to cut and the wind-up to read.

edits.before: Yorick is slow and clunky pre-6, so levels 2-3 are yours: throw Q (Thundering Shuriken) at his face and let Electrical Surge autos stack Mark of the Storm — his low base HP means a third-mark stun into a quick trade chunks him before he can answer. Dodge his E (Dark Procession) cage, because that mist ring slows you and lets his ghouls and W wall pin your fragile body for a swarm trade. Don't sit in the wave eating ghoul autos while you poke him; back off and reset the marks rather than trading HP-for-HP with a juggernaut.
edits.after: Yorick is slow and clunky pre-6, so levels 2-3 are yours: throw Q (Thundering Shuriken) at his face and let Electrical Surge autos stack Mark of the Storm — his low base HP means a third-mark stun into a quick trade chunks him before he can answer. Dodge Mourning Mist (E): it marks and slows you, strips armour and speeds his ghouls straight at you, and Dark Procession (W) then walls off your exit. Don't sit in the wave eating ghoul autos while you poke; back off and reset the marks instead.

edits.before: At 4-5 respect him — once Maiden of the Mist is up his ghouls out-DPS your poke and he can E-cage you off the wave, so chip and disengage rather than commit. But level 6 flips it hard: your Slicing Maelstrom plus the Q-W-E Flash stun-lock is a real kill button that bursts Yorick through his magic-vulnerable body before Maiden's swing decides the fight. Bait or step around his E ring first, then E-in for the third mark, ult, and blow him up — this is your window, take it.
edits.after: At 4-5 respect him — once Maiden of the Mist is up his ghouls out-DPS your poke and Dark Procession (W) walls you off the wave, so chip and disengage rather than commit. But level 6 flips it hard: Slicing Maelstrom plus the Q-W-E Flash stun-lock is a real kill button that bursts Yorick through his magic-vulnerable body before Maiden's swing decides the fight. Sidestep Mourning Mist first so the ghouls never get their speed, then E-in for the third mark, ult, and blow him up.

edits.before: This is Yorick's game, not yours. Once he has 2+ items his Maiden, ghoul swarm and E-cage zone you completely off the sidelane wave, and the moment your R is down he out-sustains and out-trades your squishy caster body in any extended fight. Don't try to 1v1 him in the side — you lose. Win on your 6 and first-item spike, then group and use your AoE R as a teamfight engager and peel tool while your team answers his splitpush.
edits.after: This is Yorick's game, not yours.
